endpoint.name: Google AI Mode answer — text, sources, products, places
endpoint.summary: Runs a prompt through Google AI Mode from a chosen country and returns the answer with its cited sources, citation pills, inline products, shopping cards, place cards, videos and sponsored ads.
endpoint.call_template: treg call cloro.google.serp.ai_mode --method POST --data '{"prompt":"what is a stock split","gl":"US","include":{"markdown":true,"html":true,"googleGoto":true}}'

cost.note: 4 base + the 2-credit sync surcharge. markdown, html and googleGoto are free. include.expandProducts is the one flag left out of the test request: it adds 1 credit per product returned, so its total is not knowable before the response — leave it off for a fixed price. A failed extraction is not charged.

gl.note: result geography, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, from AI Mode's own supported-country list. `country` is a deprecated alias.

location.note: free-text location; mutually exclusive with uule

uule.note: Google UULE location string; mutually exclusive with location

include.note: any of markdown, html, googleGoto, expandProducts. The first three are free; expandProducts adds 1 credit per expanded product, charged after the fact from the number actually returned.

siblings.name: Google AI Mode answer for a question (text only)
siblings.summary: Google's own AI Mode / AI Overview answer for a question, word for word, with answer.source naming which. deep must be 0, so the text is never written by another model; answered is false, and free, when Google shows no direct answer. Text only: no product, place or ad cards.
siblings.call_template: treg call crawl4ai.google.serp.ai_mode --query 'q=what is a stock split' --query deep=0

cost.note: treg's account price: 0.15 credits for Google's answer, 0 when there is none; the x-c4-cost header settles the charge (0.15 observed live 2026-10-09).

deep.note: must be 0: only Google's own answer

siblings.name: Get Google AI Mode answer
siblings.summary: Returns the answer Google AI Mode generates for a question, as ordered text blocks, with the sources it cited
siblings.call_template: treg call litescrape.google.serp.ai_mode --query 'q=what is photosynthesis' --query hl=en --query gl=us

cost.note: One successful API response consumes one prepaid call; failures are free.

q.example: what is the best espresso machine for a small kitchen
q.note: Question to ask, up to 2,048 characters. Required on every turn, including follow-ups.

continuable.note: Return a subsequent_request_token so this answer can be followed up, when Google offers a continuation.

subsequent_request_token.note: Token from a previous continuable response. Send it with a new q to continue that conversation; reuse the same gl, hl and location. Expires after 30 minutes. Cannot be combined with image_url.

image_url.note: Public http or https URL of an image to include in the question, up to 2,048 characters. The image may be at most 20 MB. Cannot be combined with subsequent_request_token.

location.note: Human-readable search location, such as Austin, Texas. At most 63 UTF-8 bytes. Mutually exclusive with uule.

uule.note: Pre-encoded Google location token. Mutually exclusive with location.

google_domain.note: Google domain used for the request.

gl.note: Two-letter country code used to localize results.

hl.note: Language code such as en, en-GB, or de.

device.note: Google device layout. Each device is served Google's real layout for it.

timeout.note: Optional budget for the entire request in seconds, measured from gateway receipt until the response is ready to send. Includes admission, queueing and settlement. Must be greater than 0 and at most 90. On expiry, the call is not billed and returns 503 request_deadline_exceeded with retryable=true and a request ID. Omit to retain the standard server deadline.
